name: Pilot Youth Employability Bootcamp
objective: Equip 50 young people with workplace safety awareness, CV and interview skills.
description: Two-day pilot covering HSE basics, CV writing and mock interviews.
results: 50 trained; 18 linked to internships; 92% reported improved confidence.

name: Community Food Outreach — Pilot
objective: Support vulnerable families with food packs and welfare checks.
description: Dry-food packs, baby essentials and referrals for 30 households.
results: 120 beneficiaries; 30 families supported; repeat monthly planned.
